splash.title: Clear campaigns, from brief to transfer.
splash.body: Join brand campaigns curated by the Tali team. Briefs, revisions and payout dates are all on record, so you always know what comes next without guessing or chasing.
splash.login: Already have an account? Log in
splash.point1Body: Content ideas, drafts and captions keep written revision notes. No more revisions over voice notes.
splash.point2Body: Every step has a date, from acceptance to post confirmation.
splash.point3Body: When you get paid is written before you apply, and every payout has a transfer deadline you can track.
splash.brandWhatsappMessage: Hi Tali, I'm from a brand/agency and I'd like to run a campaign with Tali creators.

legal.contactBody: For questions, data copy requests or account deletion, contact the Tali team:
legal.loginConsent: By signing in, you agree to Tali's <terms>Terms & Conditions</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

privacy.title: Who we are
body: Tali is a campaign app for nano and micro creators, run by the Tali team. This policy explains what data we collect when you use Tali, why, and how you can control it.

privacy.title: Data we collect
body: We only collect what we need to run campaigns and pay your fees:
items: Account: your email address. If you sign in with Google, we receive your name, email and profile photo from Google.

Profile: full name, phone number, province and city, content categories (niche), persona, gender and account type (personal, couple, family or group). If you are a woman, we also ask whether you wear a hijab.

Whether you wear a hijab is used only to match you with jobs that require it, such as modest-fashion campaigns. It is not used for anything else, not shown to other creators, and only shared with the client of a job you apply to. You can change it any time on your Profile page.
Shipping address, when a job requires a product to be sent to you.
Social media accounts: profile link, username and the follower count you enter.
Campaign work: storyline links (Google Docs), draft links or photos, captions, post links, purchase proof photos and revision notes.
Payout account: bank name, account number and account holder name, requested when you make your first payout request.
Technical: a login session cookie, a language cookie and (if you turn it on) your browser's push notification subscription.

privacy.title: How we use it
body: We use your data to:
items: Create and secure your account.
Match you with jobs, including verifying your social media accounts.
Run storyline, draft, caption and post reviews with the brand.
Ship products and schedule visits.
Transfer fees to your bank account and keep a payout history.
Send in-app, email and push notifications about your work.

privacy.title: What we don't do
body: We don't sell your data, we don't use third-party ads, and we don't put analytics trackers in the app. Tali emails don't track opens or clicks.

privacy.title: Who can see your data
body: Inside Tali, access is limited by role. Curators see your profile, social accounts and work. Your full account number is visible only to the finance team while processing a payout; on your own screen it is always masked.

With the brand running a campaign, we share your name or username, city, niche, persona, gender, account type, whether you wear a hijab (if you filled it in), social media links and follower counts, the work you submit and your post links. If the brand ships the product directly, your name, phone number and shipping address are shared for delivery. Your email and bank account number are never shared with brands.

privacy.title: Service providers
body: We use the following providers to run Tali. Some of their servers are outside Indonesia, and we choose providers with adequate security standards:
items: Supabase: database, login and file storage (servers in Singapore).
Railway: application servers.
Resend: email delivery (servers in Japan).
Google: sign-in with Google, if you choose it.
Your browser's push service (for example Google or Apple), if you turn on push notifications.

privacy.title: Security
body: Phone numbers, addresses and account numbers are encrypted before storage. All connections use HTTPS. Uploaded files are kept in private storage and can only be opened through temporary links by authorised people. Database access is restricted per user and per role.

privacy.title: How long we keep data
body: Account data is kept while your account is active. If you ask us to delete your account, we delete or anonymise your data within 30 days of receiving the request. Payout and transaction records are kept for as long as the law requires, for example for accounting and tax purposes.

privacy.title: Your rights
body: Under Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law, you have the right to:
items: See and get a copy of your personal data.
Correct inaccurate data. Most of it you can change yourself on the Profile page.
Ask for your account and data to be deleted.
Withdraw consent and stop using Tali at any time.

privacy.title: Under 18
body: Tali is meant for users aged 18 and over. Users under 18 may only sign up with the consent of a parent or guardian.

privacy.title: Changes
body: If this policy changes, we update the date above and let you know in the app or by email for significant changes.

terms.title: About these terms
body: By creating an account or using Tali, you agree to these terms and Tali's Privacy Policy. If you don't agree, please don't use Tali.

terms.title: Your account
items: You are at least 18 years old, or have consent from a parent or guardian.
One person may hold only one account, and the information you provide must be accurate.
The social media accounts you register must be your own and managed by you.
You are responsible for keeping access to the email or Google account you sign in with secure.

terms.title: Jobs and participation
body: All jobs on Tali are curated by the Tali team. Fee, payment terms, requirements and brief are shown before you join. For open-rate jobs, you propose your own rate within the stated cap, if any.
The Tali team may accept or decline applications, and may cancel a participation if you don't meet the requirements or don't follow the brief. The reason is recorded in the app.

terms.title: Content workflow
body: Every job follows this order:
items: The storyline (a Google Docs link) must be approved before you make a draft.
Draft and caption must be approved before you post.
Revisions are unlimited. Feedback from the Tali team and the brand is recorded separately in the app.
The post goes live as briefed, from the account registered on Tali, and you submit its link in the app for confirmation.
The post must not be deleted, archived or edited during the period set in the brief.

terms.title: Content rights
body: You remain the owner of the content you create. By joining a job, you allow Tali and the brand running the campaign to use that content within the scope and period stated in the job brief. Any use beyond the brief requires your consent.

terms.title: Fees and payouts
items: Fees can be withdrawn once your post is confirmed and the job's payment term has passed (7, 14 or 30 days after confirmation, depending on the job).
You request payouts yourself in the app, with a minimum of Rp 10,000. Several jobs can be combined in one request.
A Rp 2,500 transfer fee per request is deducted from the amount, except for BCA and Mandiri accounts.
We transfer within 3 working days of your request, excluding weekends and national holidays. The deadline and payout status are always visible in the app.
Make sure your bank details are correct. If a transfer fails because of incorrect details, the payout is marked failed and you can request it again after fixing them.
You are responsible for the taxes on your own income, unless Tali tells you otherwise.

terms.title: What's not allowed
items: Using fake or paid followers, likes, views or comments.
Registering someone else's social media account, or using someone else's Tali account.
Submitting content that breaks the law, copyright or social media platform rules.
Sharing fee amounts, unannounced brand names, briefs or other confidential campaign information.

terms.title: Account suspension
body: If you break these terms, the Tali team may suspend or close your account. Fees for work that has already been confirmed are still paid, unless that work itself breaks these terms.

terms.title: Limitation of liability
body: Tali connects creators with brand campaigns and manages the process. We work to keep the app available and its data accurate, but we can't guarantee it will be free of interruptions. We are not responsible for changes or outages on third-party social media platforms.

terms.title: Changes and governing law
body: We may update these terms and will let you know in the app or by email about significant changes. These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Indonesia. Any dispute will first be resolved through good-faith discussion.
